channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: No traders' body called for Bharat Bandh, it is business as usual in organised sector: CAIT
item.description: CAIT clarified that no major traders' body has called for a Bharat Bandh, and markets will remain open. While some banks, government offices, transport, and schools may be affected, the organised trade sector does not support the strike called by trade unions and farmer groups protesting labour codes, the India-US trade deal, and seeking MGNREGA restoration.

item.title: Mystery of 'flying coffin': Shiv Sena(UBT) raises questions in Saamana on Ajit Pawar's fatal plane crash
item.description: The political atmosphere intensified on Wednesday when the legislator Rohit Pawar, the nephew of the late Ajit Pawar, presented a detailed case suggesting that the crash near Baramati Airport was not a mere accident but a "well-planned conspiracy".

item.title: India's trade surplus with US may cross $90 billion, no impact from Bangladesh deal: SBI
item.description: India's trade surplus with the US is expected to exceed $90 billion annually following the new trade deal, with an estimated $45 billion additional surplus and $3 billion savings in forex reserves, according to an SBI report.

item.title: Gold and silver prices dip over dollar gains
item.description: Gold and silver prices dipped on Thursday as the US dollar strengthened following strong US jobs data. MCX gold April futures fell 0.24% to Rs 1,58,371 per 10 grams, and MCX silver March futures declined 0.72% to Rs 2,61,124 per kg.

item.title: US expects tariff follow-through: White House
item.description: The White House stated that the US expects India to honor tariff reduction commitments under President Trump's trade agreement, calling it a win for American farmers, workers, and industries.

item.title: Tiruppur textile cluster should create 5 lakh new jobs, govt to support exporters: Piyush Goyal
item.description: Goyal encouraged stakeholders to leverage opportunities from Free Trade Agreements (FTAs), including the India–EU FTA and the interim US trade deal, expected to boost textile and apparel exports.

item.title: CJ Roy death case: SIT finds no evidence of alleged harassment by I-T Department
item.description: Investigators are examining his mental health, personal relationships, and financial dealings, including audits of company transactions, to determine if business pressures or regulatory scrutiny contributed to his stress.

item.title: Bharat Bandh: 'What did Cong do for workers during its rule', NFITU supports reforms
item.description: The National Front of Indian Trade Unions (NFITU) dismissed the Bharat Bandh as politically motivated, alleging it is driven by Congress and Left parties rather than genuine worker concerns.

item.title: RBI proposes ban on 3rd‑party sales incentives to bank staff to curb mis-selling
item.description: Banks must not bundle third-party products with their own, must refund mis-sold products, and compensate customers for losses. Customers can lodge complaints within 30 days, and banks must seek feedback within 30 days of any sale and report half-yearly.

item.title: Bharat Bandh disrupts daily life, livelihoods across Kerala
item.description: Shops, markets, offices, schools, and public transport were largely shut, severely affecting daily life and livelihoods, especially daily wage earners, small traders, and street vendors.
